name: input-tick
prompt: A very short, soft mechanical toggle click, like a light plastic switch flicked once, dry and close, no reverb.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: A short low-pitched error buzz, like a small electric buzzer denying entry, muted and not harsh, single quick burst.

name: can-pickup-low
prompt: A bright metallic ding of a small tin can being plucked off the ground, single resonant ping with a quick decay.

name: can-pickup-mid
prompt: A cheerful metallic clink of an aluminum can tapped once and lifted, slightly higher pitched ping, short ring-out.

name: can-pickup-high
prompt: A sparkling high metal chime, like a coin-sized can lid flicked with a fingernail, crisp and brief.

name: checkpoint-chime
prompt: A two-note ascending bell chime on a small brass gate bell, clear and encouraging, gentle natural decay.

name: soft-landing
prompt: A soft cushioned thump, like a tired suspension settling gently onto packed dirt, low and rounded, no rattle.

name: hard-landing
prompt: A heavy suspension bottom-out thud with a short metal creak, like a vehicle slamming onto gravel, dull and weighty.

name: vehicle-crash
prompt: A crunching metal impact, crumpling fender and rattling debris of a small off-road buggy crashing into rock, one hard hit with brief scatter.

name: finish-fanfare
prompt: A short triumphant brass fanfare, four rising notes on a small trumpet, bright and celebratory, clean ending.

name: ui-click
prompt: A single clean UI button click, like a small plastic key pressed on a handheld device, short and neutral.

name: countdown-beep
prompt: A single clear electronic countdown beep, mid-pitched sine tone with a soft attack, like a race timer tick.

name: go-horn
prompt: A short punchy air-horn style start signal, single bright honk, energetic but small, like a toy race starter horn.
